text: Removing/forwarding/merging/hoisting loads, divisions, pointer operations, or guards shall preserve or prove absent all applicable domain, readiness, initialization, race, synchronization, resource, and terminal-prefix effects. Proven reached failures may become their selected terminal event, never an impossible-path assumption.
